columns.name: Year
columns.description: The calendar year during which the prevailing wage work was performed.

columns.name: Quarter
columns.description: The quarter of the reporting year (Q1, Q2, Q3, or Q4) during which the prevailing wage work was performed.

columns.name: Project County
columns.description: The Illinois county where the public works project is located. Used to identify regional trends in prevailing wage activity.

columns.name: Project Number
columns.description: The project name or number as reported by the contractor. This number is used for tracking and referencing project-specific wage and employment data.

columns.name: Company Name
columns.description: The name of the contractor reporting prevailing wage information for the project.

columns.name: Percent Male Apprentice
columns.description: Percentage of male apprentices (workers undergoing structured training in a skilled trade).

columns.name: Percent Male Journeyworker
columns.description: Percentage of male journeyworkers (fully qualified skilled tradespeople who have completed apprenticeships).

columns.name: Percent Male Neither
columns.description: Percentage of male employees who are classified as neither journeyworkers nor apprentices in skilled trade positions.

columns.name: Percent Female Apprentice
columns.description: Percentage of female apprentices (workers undergoing structured training in a skilled trade).

columns.name: Percent Female Journeyworker
columns.description: Percentage of female journeyworkers (fully qualified skilled tradespeople who have completed apprenticeships).

columns.name: Percent Female Neither
columns.description: Percentage of female employees who are classified as neither journeyworkers nor apprentices in skilled trade positions.
